audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while the content layer's win[N] read LeBlanc for rows 0-5 and Cassiopeia for row 6 — the page rendered two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: 55.61% over 651 games, plus a kit that has no dash and a 24s Miasma, supports LeBlanc winning rows 0-5; whys[6] and the packet levelChart both already place row 6 with Cassiopeia once Rylai's/Liandry's are online.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side -> LeBlanc, phases[6].side -> Cassiopeia, ratings adjusted and phases[6].why rewritten so the row and its sentence agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text referred to 'Noxious Trap' zone control (packet flagged it) and claimed her late ultimate 'one-shots through Zhonya's'.
audit.why: Cassiopeia has no Noxious Trap — Q is Noxious Blast and the grounding zone is Miasma (W), 24/22/20/18/16. Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80 and stuns enemies facing her; nothing in her kit ignores stasis.
audit.corrected: Miasma named with its real cooldown; the late spike re-grounded on Miasma denying your escape plus an 80s Petrifying Gaze.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was described only as 'Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it', and the page repeatedly told you to 'dash in with E'.
audit.why: LeBlanc's dash is Distortion (W, 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10) and its value is the return cast within 4 seconds. Miasma carries the grounding flag, so a LeBlanc caught inside it has neither the entry dash nor the exit — that is the whole matchup, and it was never stated. Twin Fang (0.75s, heals for a percentage of damage) is the other half: extended trades are healed back.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated as denying both the dash in and the return; Twin Fang sustain named with Oblivion Orb as the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and the packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: Miasma 24s->16s and Petrifying Gaze 120s->80s against your own 15s Distortion are the numbers that make 'wait, then go' concrete.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with real numbers; dos/donts bodies re-keyed to Miasma's 24s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere, despite the brief's missingInteractions entry.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia for a percentage of the damage dealt and is on a 0.75s cooldown, so any trade that lasts is refunded to her.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb named in the itemization line, replacing the misgendered generic 'anti-heal into his sustain'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nine misgendered fields (Cassiopeia called he/his/him) plus two copy-paste bleeds.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her and with bodies that match their titles.

edits.before: Cassiopeia's early kit is deceptively soft — no dash, and Twin Fang only resets off already-poisoned targets, meaning her damage ramps up over multiple hits rather than bursting you like you burst her. Dash in with E while she's still building poison stacks and she has no way to disengage since her passive speed only kicks in once she's poisoned you first. Look for all-ins around 3-5 before she has full rank in Noxious Trap zone control.
edits.after: Cassiopeia's early kit is deceptively soft — no dash, and Twin Fang deals its real damage only into already-poisoned targets, so her output ramps over multiple hits rather than bursting you like you burst her. W in while she's still building poison and she has no way to disengage, since Serpentine Grace only helps once her poison is already on you. Look for all-ins at 3-5 while Miasma is still 24s and cannot ground your exit.

edits.before: This matchup flips hard once she's 2-3 items deep — Rylai's/Liandry's DoT plus a fully-stacked Petrify facing you means she can delete your entire HP bar in one rotation, even through a Zhonya's. Your job is to have ended the game or built a big enough lead before this point; if it goes late you need to engage from unusual angles and never let her face you directly in a poisoned state.
edits.after: This matchup flips hard once she's 2-3 items deep — Rylai's/Liandry's poison plus an 80s Petrifying Gaze on anyone facing her means one rotation takes your whole bar.
